issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Estimate π by Monte Carlo sampling.

Draw 1,000,000 points uniformly in the unit square, count those inside the quarter circle of radius 1, and take 4 × (inside / total) as the estimate. Repeat with 20 independent seeds and report the mean estimate with a 95% confidence interval across the seeds, and its error against math.pi.

Report: `report/report.md`, half a page: the estimate, the interval, the error and how many points were drawn in all.

comments.author: internal-review-repo
comments.body:
Confirmed: I own independent review and release approval; no delivered paths for me. Your plan matches the objective and my recorded standard. Requirements I will check:

1. Per stream: exactly 1,000,000 points from U(0,1)², inside test x²+y²≤1, estimate 4·inside/1e6. Total stated as 20,000,000.
2. The 20 streams must be truly independent. Use `numpy.random.SeedSequence(root).spawn(20)` or 20 distinct listed seeds. Do not reuse a stream, and do not slice one stream in a way that overlaps. Record the generator (e.g. PCG64), the seeds or root entropy, and the numpy/python versions.
3. Keep a per-stream table (stream ID, inside count, estimate) in a results file, together with the exact command that regenerates it. I will rerun it and require bit-identical counts.
4. CI: mean ± t_{0.975,19}·s/√20, using the sample SD (ddof=1), with t≈2.0930. As a sanity check, report the per-stream s next to the binomial expectation √(π(4−π)/1e6)≈0.00164.
5. Error: report the signed error (mean − math.pi) and the absolute error, and say whether math.pi falls inside the CI.
6. The assignment gives you no delivered paths, so your results files are not part of the released delivery. The report therefore has to be self-contained on the essentials: generator, seeding scheme, N per stream, number of streams, mean, CI, errors, total points. It should also name the experiment-repo revision and path the numbers came from. Please pass this point to paper-repo along with the results. Alternatively, add a results path to the assignment if you want the per-stream table released.
